source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005, ספר החוקים 2009 (ס"ח תשס"ה, 889): s.1 (p.2), s.13 (p.8: "הממונה רשאי לאשר"), s.39(א) (p.15: a managing company is under the Commissioner's supervision)

regulator.notes: A study fund is a provident fund "intended to pay study allowances" (s.1); managing companies are under the Commissioner's supervision (s.39(א)) and the fund is approved under s.13.

source.title: תקנות הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל) (דמי ניהול), התשע"ב-2012, ק"ת 7131, p.1262 (file p.6), reg. 4: a keren hishtalmut or an IRA may charge from the balance "בשיעור שלא יעלה על 2% לשנה"

balance.notes: Maximum management fee of a study fund, per year, of each member's accumulated balance; applies to each track as a separate account (reg. 6). In force since 1.1.2013. Reg. 4 authorises only a fee on the balance, so no deposit fee; the regulator's statement circular 2020-9-22 (p.37) states it (KH-22), and Gemel-Net reports no deposit fee on any study-fund track (KH-23). Reported averages for 2026-09: 0.34% to 0.74% outside IRA tracks (KH-23).

source.title: חוזר גופים מוסדיים 2020-9-22 – דוח שנתי ודוח רבעוני לעמיתים ולמבוטחים בגוף מוסדי – תיקון, p.37, chapter 1 sign ב, direction ג.1: the deposit-fee row is 0% "למעט במקרים בהם לא ניתן לגבות דמי ניהול מהפקדה כגון: קופה בניהול אישי, קרן השתלמות, קופה לפי הוצאות בפועל"
source.publisher: Capital Market, Insurance and Savings Authority (gov.il)

deposit.notes: Reg. 4 authorises only a fee on the balance and law s.32(א) forbids any charge not allowed, so a study fund charges no deposit fee. The regulator states it: its statement circular names a study fund among the cases "בהם לא ניתן לגבות דמי ניהול מהפקדה", in an exception to a reporting direction (circular 2020-9-22, p.37), and the Commissioner's 2025 report gives the deposit-fee average for provident funds other than study funds, "שבהן אין דמי ניהול מהפקדה" (chart ד-3) (KH-22).

labels: institution source: real base of the 25% on gains from deposits above the benefited amount (TXH-11)
early withdrawal (F-47), which the person opts into (B3): taxed at marginal rates, 47% withheld (TXH-13, TXH-15); the linkage part of the gains taxed is a reading for an employee (TXH-13)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.9(16א)(א)-(ד) and s.9(16ב) (Tax Authority's text, p.43); Altshuler Shaham study-fund bylaws 1.12.2024, s.9.1

years.notes: Exempt withdrawal, for any purpose, from the end of 6 years from the first payment date (the earlier of the end of the month the first payment was paid in and the end of the month it was paid for, not before the start of that tax year). 3 years at retirement age or for the member's study (TXH-10, KH-12). After any withdrawal the account closes to further payments; later deposits open a new account with a new clock (KH-15). Earlier withdrawal is allowed and taxed (TXH-13), not forbidden.

source.title: תקנות מס הכנסה (כללים לאישור ולניהול קופות גמל) (תיקון מס' 3), התשס"ה-2005, קובץ התקנות 6380 (10.4.2005), סריקת רשומות, file p.3 (gazette p.603), reg. 9 (in reg. 41יא '5 ימי עסקים' becomes '4 ימי עסקים', with the deferral to the fourth business day of the month); reg. 41יא itself as substituted by קובץ התקנות 6332, file p.19 (gazette p.873), reg. 44
source.quote: רשאית הקופה לדחות את מועד התשלום ליום העסקים הרביעי באותו חודש

payout_business_days.notes: Rule 41יא(א) of the 1964 Income Tax Rules: a provident fund pays a withdrawal within 4 business days of the day the request reaches it; if that date falls in the month's first three business days it may defer to the 4th business day of the month. The law's timetable for every fund, not one company's (scope pass 2026-10-25). The documents and channel each manager asks for are its own (Altshuler Shaham's: KH-27).

lawful_exit.text: the money becomes free 6 years after the first payment date (3 years at retirement age, or for the member's study); withdrawing earlier is allowed but taxed as work income on the employer's benefited deposits and at the rates for income not from personal effort on the gains, with 47% withheld (TXH-13, TXH-15; method F-47, which the study fund visual computes when the year picked is before the lock ends); the 2025 to 2027 proposals to narrow the exemption are not law (TXH-22)

source.title: Ministry of Finance, Chief Economist, "על הטבת המס בקרן השתלמות – ניתוח מדיניות", October 2025, p.5 item 2 ("פטור ממס רווחי הון בעת שינוי הרכב הנכסים (דחיית מס)"); Income Tax Rules 1964, rule 33ב

switch_is_tax_event.notes: A track switch inside the fund is not a tax event and is completed within 3 business days. A whole-balance transfer to another study fund carries the account's history (TXH-19); no primary text says in so many words that it is not a withdrawal (TXH OQ11).

transfer_routes.condition: whole balance only; no partial transfer
only money the member could withdraw tax-exempt
only money the member could withdraw tax-exempt

eligibility.text: a salaried employee only through an employer that pays in under a personal contract, a collective agreement or an extension order, usually 7.5% employer and 2.5% employee of salary; a self-employed person with business or professional income may open one at any time and deduct up to 4.5% of income

protection.text: assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and cannot be attached; if the company fails, management moves to another company; the state does not guarantee the fund's value; bylaws allow loans against the fund and a pledge only once the money is withdrawable
